audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet and with their own whys[] text: Level 2 read Skill while whys[1] says she keeps punishing your trades, Level 3 and Levels 4-5 read Yone while whys[2] and whys[3] both call them skill windows, and Level 6 read Illaoi while whys[4] says your Soul Unbound keeps it a skill fight.
audit.why: The packet chart — Illaoi, Illaoi, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yone, Yone — matches the prose row for row at a 51.06% win rate over 1694 games.
audit.corrected: Illaoi, Illaoi, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yone, Yone.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; the page tells you to track Test of Spirit without ever saying how long it is down.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 falling to 12s — that is the window your whole pattern lives in. Harsh Lesson is a flat 4s dash and auto-reset. Tentacle Smash is 10s to 6s. Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s. Your Soul Unbound falls 22s to 10s; Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Commit inside the 16-second Test of Spirit gap; treat the 4-second Harsh Lesson as always available rather than something to wait out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Harsh Lesson (W) is never mentioned anywhere on the page, Test of Spirit is called 'Tentacle (E)' in two places, the Vessel condition is never stated, and Fate Sealed is described as setting up team knockups.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is the engine of the matchup: a 4-second dash that resets her auto AND makes every nearby tentacle swing at whoever she hits — that is why standing near tentacles is fatal, not the tentacles' own timers. Test of Spirit's spirit echoes a share of the damage it takes back onto you, and if the spirit dies OR you walk too far from it you become a Vessel and start spawning tentacles yourself, so running away from your own spirit is a mistake. Her passive heals her whenever a tentacle damages a champion, which is what makes anti-heal core. Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls; the knockup here is your own Mortal Steel at two Gathering Storm stacks.
audit.corrected: Named Harsh Lesson and its 4s tentacle trigger; stated the Vessel condition on both sides; Fate Sealed corrected to a blink-behind and pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Leap of Faith with grounding and untargetable flags.
audit.why: Riot's own description of Leap of Faith says only that it smashes the idol for physical damage and spawns a tentacle per champion hit — no grounding and no untargetability. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description over the derived flags and asserted neither. If the grounding flag were real it would be the single most important fact in this matchup for a dash-reliant champion, so it is worth a human check.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim written to the page.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last enemy and pulls; it never knocks up. Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1 and spawns a tentacle per champion hit.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Illaoi carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls the enemies it clips toward you instead of knocking them up. Illaoi carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1; Harsh Lesson is 4s and makes tentacles swing. Q3-R the gap.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her passive heals her every time a tentacle lands on a champion.

edits.before: Illaoi is dangerous early: Tentacle (E) spirit-pull plus tentacle slaps punish any greedy trade, and standing in her tentacle field with Q slams melts you, so never trade near stacked tentacles.
edits.after: Illaoi is dangerous early: Test of Spirit (E) is 16s at rank 1, and Harsh Lesson (W) on a 4s cooldown makes every nearby tentacle swing at you at once — never trade near stacked tentacles.

edits.before: Illaoi owns levels 1-2: her Tentacle (E) and passive slaps out-trade you, and if you fight inside her tentacle field her Q slams stack damage faster than your W-shield can absorb, so farm at range and respect the E skillshot. Eating a spirit-pull this early can lose you the lane outright.
edits.after: Illaoi owns levels 1-2: her Test of Spirit (E) and passive slaps out-trade you, and inside her tentacle field a 4-second Harsh Lesson (W) makes every tentacle swing at you at once, so farm at range and respect the E skillshot. Eating a spirit-pull this early can lose the lane outright.

notes: Harsh Lesson (W) was completely absent from the page even though it is the mechanic that makes her tentacle field lethal: a 4-second dash and auto-reset that forces every nearby tentacle to swing at the target. Added to spikes[0] and early. 'Tentacle (E)' corrected to Test of Spirit, and the Vessel condition — spirit dies or you stray too far — is now stated on both the wants.you and wants.foe side.
